posts.author: iloveruby
posts.paraphrase: Opening post. They need a work bag for a 17.3-inch laptop; most bags they find are for small laptops. Asks for recommendations that can be delivered next day.
posts.quote: they all seem to be for teeny laptops, mine is 17.3 inches

posts.author: TizerorFizz
posts.paraphrase: Suggests Amazon Prime has plenty of practical rather than stylish options. Says most women's work bags fit up to 15-inch laptops and the Osprey bags on sale are too small.
posts.quote: Most women's work bags take up to 15 inch laptops.

posts.author: iloveruby
posts.paraphrase: Thanks them but doubts their laptop will fit in the Osprey bags.
posts.quote: I don't think my laptop will fit :-(

posts.author: Splicebaked
posts.paraphrase: Recently bought a Wenger laptop bag from Lidl that also holds files; previously bought Wenger luggage from Tesco with vouchers. Praises the quality and suggests checking Lidl's middle aisle, about £19.99.
posts.quote: They're such brilliant quality. Go into your local Lidl

posts.author: Splicebaked
posts.paraphrase: Clarifies their Lidl Wenger bag is sold as a messenger bag rather than a laptop bag.
posts.quote: Mines called a Messenger Bag rather than a laptop bag

posts.author: Splicebaked
posts.paraphrase: Corrects themselves: their bag only takes a 16-inch laptop, so it would not fit the 17.3-inch one.

posts.author: LurpakAspirations
posts.paraphrase: Recommends buying a slim protective laptop case from Amazon and carrying it inside a tote bag.
posts.quote: I would opt for a slimline protective case for your laptop - available on amazon, various styles

posts.author: Splicebaked
posts.paraphrase: Says their household uses Amazon laptop sleeves with a neoprene-type outer and softer lining.
posts.quote: They're made from a sort of neoprene material with a softer lining.

posts.author: TizerorFizz
posts.paraphrase: Says few totes are deep enough at the base and many are V-shaped with open tops. For a laptop this size a wheeled case is often better because of the weight; their daughter's high-spec CAD laptop is heavier than a MacBook-type machine.
posts.quote: For this size a wheeled case is often better due to weight of laptop.

posts.author: TizerorFizz
posts.paraphrase: Shares a large M&S bag but suspects the listed measurement is only the top width.
posts.quote: is big but I suspect the measurement is the top width.

posts.author: Loiste
posts.paraphrase: Not sure about next-day delivery, but they use a backpack for their heavy work laptop; it works well and they like it more than they expected.
posts.quote: It does the trick and I like it much more than I ever expected I would!

posts.author: Gwenhwyfar
posts.paraphrase: Disagrees with the tote suggestion: carrying a laptop on one side is bad for the back and shoulder.
posts.quote: not good for your back/shoulder to carry our laptop just on one side.

posts.author: TizerorFizz
posts.paraphrase: Agrees with Gwenhwyfar and says wheeled trolley bags work best.
posts.quote: Trolley bags on wheels work best.
